resolved_conflicts.explanation: The list calls the tower Nig Field and pairs it with mark GB2578. The datasheet for GB2578 titles the mark Bowman Lookout Tower NC 27 and places the tower on Bowman Mountain. This record uses the list name and notes the survey name.

notes_for_editor: The 1961 datasheet gives the tower as 70 feet high; height_m 21.3 is that figure converted, and it is the tower height, not elevation. Elevation 3,241 ft is from the list only. No access level is recorded: no source describes access to this site. A Facebook post about Caryville Mountain (Nig Field) came back empty when fetched, so it is not cited. Name conflict: the list says Nig Field, the survey says Bowman Lookout Tower; the GB2578 position (36 17 01.95 N, 084 17 17.21 W) matches the brief's coordinates. The NHLR and FFLOS Tennessee lists (both read) do not include this tower, so no registry event is recorded.
